list.title: Career Studio
list.intro: Create polished professional documents. Writing and previewing are free; you only pay for the PDF export.
list.emptyBody: Start with your CV: it will be the basis for your letters.
list.deleteBody: The document will disappear from your list.

hints.recipient: Enter the person or department you are writing to, if you know it.
hints.date: Leave empty to use today’s date.
hints.body: Separate paragraphs with an empty line. Only write accurate information.
hints.enclosures: One item per line, for example “Curriculum vitae”.

placeholders.recipientAddress: E.g. Route de Rufisque, PO Box 1234

subjects.cover_letter: E.g. Application for the accountant position
subjects.internship_request: E.g. Request for a six-month accounting internship
subjects.recommendation_draft: E.g. Letter of recommendation for Awa Diallo
subjects.resignation_letter: E.g. Resignation from the accountant position
subjects.follow_up_letter: E.g. Follow-up on my application for the accountant position
subjects.thank_you_letter: E.g. Thank you for our interview

guides.cover_letter: Explain why this position interests you, what you bring to the company, and suggest an interview.
guides.application_letter: Present your profile, the kind of position you are looking for and your availability, even without a published vacancy.
guides.internship_request: State your studies, the length and dates of the internship, and what you hope to learn.
guides.recommendation_draft: Draft for the person recommending you to review and sign: accurate facts only.
guides.resignation_letter: State your decision, the intended last day taking notice into account, and your thanks.
guides.follow_up_letter: Recall the date and position of your application and briefly restate your interest.
guides.thank_you_letter: Thank them for the interview, mention a highlight of the conversation and confirm your interest.

letter.bodyPlaceholder: E.g. With a bachelor’s degree in accounting, I would like to apply…
